answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 21267 Country: India Title: I have kept my daughters name as "Afrah" after seeing the meaning on Internet as "Happiness". But few people have told me that the meaning of Arfah is not good ( Something related to dust or evil). Can you please advise me. If the meaning is not good should i keep "Kulsum"? Question: Assalam Alaikum. I have kept my daughters name as "Afrah" after seeing the meaning on Internet as "Happiness". But few people have told me that the meaning of Arfah is not good ( Something related to dust or evil). Can you please advise me. If the meaning is not good should i keep "Kulsum"? Answer ID: 21267 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 490/490/M=1431) We could not find the meaning of Afrah ( افرح ) as dust in dictionary. However, it is better to choose Umm Kulsum for your daughter. It is the name of one of the daughters of the holy Prophet Muhammad ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
